Core Pillar: Event Mobility

Mastering Complex Route Architecture.

Moving 5,000 delegates requires more than just vehicles. It requires a Transport Control Room. We provide end-to-end logistics management for GCC mega-events, ensuring precision from tarmac to venue.

Delivery Schedules & Route Planning

Dynamic routing mapped to avoid local congestion, maximizing efficiency for convention shuttles and VIP movements.

Traffic & On-Site Parking Management

Ground coordinators dispatching our luxury coach and executive bus fleet to maintain seamless loading/unloading zones.

Post-Event Passenger Analytics

Comprehensive reporting on passenger volumes, vehicle utilization, and operational KPIs delivered to event organizers.

Managed Transportation

How a managed Transportation works with AB

Four stages, one accountable partner. Select a stage to see what happens.

01

Brief.

You share dates, passenger numbers, locations and service levels and other requirements.

  • Dates
  • Passenger numbers
  • Locations
  • Service levels
02

Plan.

Our planners set the vehicle mix, routes, timings and standby fleet, and agree with you in writing and create SLAs.

  • Vehicle mix
  • Routes & timings
  • Standby fleet
  • Written SLAs
03

Operate.

Chauffeurs, drivers and on-site coordinators run the plan. The event control room tracks every vehicle and handles changes as they happen. Our Teams in each Country Operational control room monitors and assist the deliverables.

  • Chauffeurs & coordinators
  • Event control room
  • Country control rooms
Every vehicle tracked in real time
04

Report.

You receive trip records, on-time performance and a single consolidated invoice.

  • Trip records
  • On-time performance
  • One consolidated invoice

Uncompromising Duty of Care.

We integrate seamlessly with your corporate travel policies, providing the technological transparency and rigorous safety standards required by global enterprises.

Intelligent Transport Systems

Proprietary live GPS tracking allowing corporate security teams to monitor Executive Protection Services and standard rides in real-time.

Corporate Tech Integration

Centralized corporate billing with direct API integrations to expense management platforms like SAP Concur for frictionless accounting.

Vetted Professionalism

Our Vehicle Governance

Events & festivals2021 – 2025
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

MDL Beast Soundstorm Festival

725Vehicles at peak
145K+Attendees
250+Artists moved
View case study

The region's premier music event, held over three days and attracting more than 145,000 attendees and 86,000 vehicles daily. Across the 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025 editions, AB delivered a comprehensive transportation solution for both staff and artists, operating 725 vehicles at the peak of the event.

Staff services

  • Dedicated team for bookings and dispatch
  • On-site and accommodation coordinators
  • Airport transfer services
  • Shuttle buses between accommodation and the festival site
  • Dedicated executive fleet and team serving MDL Beast managers

Artist services

  • Dedicated booking and dispatch office
  • Coordinators at the airport and on-site
  • Transfers between the airport and the event venue
  • Luxury buses between hotels and the festival site
  • 230 luxury vehicles allocated for 250+ artists and their teams
Giga-projects2025 – present
NEOM, Saudi Arabia

NEOM Trojena Project

18Luxury coaches / month
24/7Dispatch support
View case study

In collaboration with a consortium, AB delivered large-scale staff transportation for the Trojena Development at NEOM from March 2025 onwards, deploying 18 luxury coaches on a monthly basis to support 12-hour daily operations, six days a week.

What we delivered

  • Morning and evening shifts with licensed drivers
  • On-site project management
  • 24/7 dispatch support
  • Modern, fully insured fleet under a preventive maintenance programme

Outcome

  • Zero major service disruptions
  • High operational reliability in a remote project environment
  • From July 2025, structured project transport for other construction clients across Trojena, with centralised dispatch, GPS-equipped vehicles and full regulatory compliance
Sports2022
Doha, Qatar

FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022

AllStadiums covered
<3Months to deliver
View case study

AB Transportation and Six Degrees Transport provided consulting in traffic and transportation management for the "Last Mile" and "Zone X" strategy teams for all stadiums, and AB delivered Rate Card transport services for teams through the FIFA "Friends and Family" programme.

Implemented activities

  • Traffic management consultancy to implement safe lanes in "Zone X" and the "Last Mile"
  • Connecting spectator parking and transport hubs to stadium entry points within the secure perimeter
  • Rate Card Transport Programme planned and executed in less than three months

Capabilities proven

  • Traffic management strategies for football stadiums
  • In-depth understanding of "Zone X" and "Last Mile" operations
  • Rapid operational planning and mobilisation of equipment and personnel
Events & exhibitions2024 & 2025
Abu Dhabi, UAE

ADIPEC VIP Shuttle Services

VIPGuest shuttles
2Consecutive editions
View case study

AB Transportation UAE delivered dedicated shuttle bus services for VIP guests attending ADIPEC in Abu Dhabi. Despite short notice, our team ensured smooth, efficient and professional transport operations fully aligned with the expectations of high-profile international attendees.

Guest shuttle operations

  • Fleet of premium buses for VIP guests
  • Routes between hotels, event venues and designated access points
  • Each route planned to minimise waiting times and optimise traffic flow

Planning & execution

  • Requirements assessment through to full deployment
  • Route planning, site preparation and real-time bus tracking
  • On-ground coordination with staff briefed for exceptional hospitality
